title: Add token-path entropy metric, high-entropy log gating, and alert circuit-breaker
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Introduce a new token-level metric (token_path_entropy) and an alert circuit-breaker to reduce noisy long-tail alerts. Adds a dashboard panel and a log-gating toggle to limit high-fidelity trace capture for high-entropy invocations. No behavioral changes to customer-facing APIs.
description:
Context and motivation:
We see frequent noisy alerting and large trace payloads driven by a small number of high-entropy token sequences (e.g., user-provided code blobs, encoded binary in prompts, or adversarial long random strings). These requests have low signal for SLOs and produce a disproportionate volume of high-fidelity logs and traces, increasing cost and alert churn.

What this PR does (summary):
- Adds a new metric 'token_path_entropy' emitted per invocation that estimates the Shannon entropy of the token sequence path (rolling window over final N tokens).
- Adds runtime gating to reduce full-trace/log capture for invocations where token_path_entropy > entropy_threshold (configurable per-tenant). This is a sampling/gating control that preserves metadata and light metrics while skipping heavy payload attachment.
- Introduces an alert circuit-breaker rule: when the system detects a sustained increase in high-entropy invocations that drive alert noise without correlated SLO regressions, the circuit-breaker automatically scales alert thresholds and quiets low-signal alert groups for a cooldown window.
- Adds a dedicated Grafana dashboard (Observability / Token Entropy) with panels for entropy distribution, high-entropy invocation rate, correlation to token-cost and latency, and circuit-breaker state timeline.
- Tuning and defaults: entropy_threshold default tuned conservatively to avoid suppressing valid signals; circuit-breaker default uses a 30m warmup and 6h decay.

Checklist:
- [x] Metric instrumentation (ingest + event model)
- [x] Runtime gating flag + tenant config surface
- [x] Dashboard and panels
- [x] Alert rule and circuit-breaker implementation with feature flag
- [x] Unit tests for metric calculation and gating logic
- [x] Integration smoke tests for alert behavior in staging
- [x] Docs: config guide and runbook (docs/observability/entropy-runbook.md)

Commit summary:
- feat(obs): compute token_path_entropy per invocation (lib/telemetry/token_entropy.go)
- feat(obs): emit entropy histogram and percentile rollups to metrics router (telemetry/publishers/metrics_router.go)
- feat(runtime): add gating hook to trace collector and tenant-level config (runtime/tracing/gating.go)
- feat(dash): add Grafana dashboard JSON and README (dashboards/token-entropy.json, dashboards/README.md)
- feat(alerts): implement circuit-breaker orchestration and rules (alerts/circuit_breaker.go)
- test(obs): unit and integration tests for entropy and gating (telemetry/token_entropy_test.go, e2e/entropy-smoke.sh)

Diff highlights (high level):
- lib/telemetry/token_entropy.go: new module with two public functions: EstimateEntropy(sequence[]) and EntropyScoreRollup(invocation). Algorithm: normalized soft-bucketed Shannon estimate (fast, streaming-friendly).
- runtime/tracing/gating.go: new gating path checked at span finalization; adds tenant config lookup and a short-circuit to avoid attaching full log blobs.
- alerts/circuit_breaker.go: state machine with counters and cooldown windows; metrics exported for circuit state changes.
- dashboards/token-entropy.json: dashboard with 6 panels; includes an explainer in panel descriptions and links to runbook.
- docs/observability/entropy-runbook.md: operational guide for oncall: how to diagnose, manually override, tuning knobs.

Testing and validation (summary):
- Unit tests: token_entropy_test covers edge cases (short sequences, identical tokens, unicode payloads).
- Integration: staging run with synthetic high-entropy payload generator; verified that gated traces reduced storage by ~68% and reduced alert volume for a noisy alert group by 84% without any SLO signal change.
- Load: local micro-benchmarks show entropy estimate adds ~0.2ms per invocation on p95 across 8k sequence lengths when implemented with soft-buckets.

Review notes and risk assessment:
- Risk: misconfigured entropy_threshold could suppress legitimate signals. Mitigations: conservative default, config per-tenant, and a manual override in Console. The runbook explains emergency steps to re-enable full fidelity.
- Observability: added explicit metrics for high_entropy_invocations_total and circuit_breaker_state to allow rapid validation after rollout.
